facts.fact: Meta and University of Oxford professors reported that the right media mix can lift brand mindset by 50% or more.
facts.quote: found that the right media mix can lift brand mindset by 50% or more.

facts.fact: EMARKETER projected that global advertising spending will approach $900 billion USD in 2024, of which almost $675 billion USD is digital.
facts.quote: global advertising spending will approach $900 billion USD (almost $675 billion USD in digital) in 2024

facts.fact: A 2022 Meta study found that total ROI across all media channels, including long-term effects, is 2.5 times higher than short-term ROI.
facts.quote: The study found that the total ROI across all media channels, when including long-term effects, is 2.5 times higher than the short-term ROI.

facts.fact: According to the Meta 2022 study, branding's long-term effects translate to a 60% boost in long-term ROI for most major industries.
facts.quote: This translates to a 60% boost in long-term ROI for most major industries.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt article states that the average campaign could be 2.5 times more effective with a different spending allocation, a claim given without a cited source.
facts.quote: The average campaign could be 2.5x more effective with a different spending allocation.

facts.fact: Following Binet and Field's recommendation, the article suggests allocating 60% of the media budget to intent/branding channels measured by reach and frequency.
facts.quote: following Binet and Field’s recommendation of allocating 60% of the budget.

facts.fact: Following Binet and Field's advice, the article suggests allocating 40% of the media budget to ROAS-focused lower-funnel channels such as search and social.
facts.quote: This follows Binet and Field’s advice to allocate 40% of the budget to these channels.

facts.fact: The article lists Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), Cost Per Install (CPI), and Return on Investment (ROI) as starting-point advertising KPIs.
